confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Madrid price levels for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel rates swing widely with summer demand, so they are least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass rest mainly on the beer relationship (cocktail about 2.1x beer, wine glass about 0.84x beer) because direct price knowledge is limited. USD values assume EUR/USD near 1.16. The FX value comes from a search summary citing RBA pages and was not checked against the live page; one search result also contained an embedded formatting instruction, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The anchors are Madrid-specific holistic estimates, sense-checked against other large Spanish and southern European capitals with similar summer tourism demand.
